How we work

Four workstreams. One transition.

RE.Think operates across the full stack of what Africa's energy transition requires — from de-risking early-stage projects to shaping the policy that unlocks capital at scale.

We identify, de-risk, and bundle early-stage renewable projects across markets — aggregating fragmented demand into portfolios large enough to attract institutional capital and EPC partners.

Site Origination Demand Aggregation Bankability

We research and pilot the storage chemistries and grid intelligence Africa's power systems will run on — building the technical foundation for a grid that is resilient, distributed, and AI-optimized.

Battery Storage Grid AI Pilot Deployments

We advise governments and regulators on the frameworks that make renewable investment bankable — and build the local institutional capacity needed to sustain that pipeline long after we're gone.

Regulatory Advisory Institutional Capacity Market Design

We work to bring component manufacturing and assembly onto the continent — reducing cost, currency exposure, and lead times while building the industrial base the transition depends on.

Local Manufacturing Supply Chain Industrial Policy
